A1.justification: Both complete 40-page PDFs describe UR2 and include appendices A–E. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish localized differences on pages 1 and 17, with no missing scientific material.

before.justification: v4.pdf reports original UR2 training and evaluation results across reasoning and question-answering tasks, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, retrieval analyses, and case studies.

after.justification: v5.pdf retains these original empirical results in the main text and appendices, including Tables 1–14 and the Appendix E case studies.

M1.justification: The LLM-summarized retrieval mechanism, difficulty-aware curriculum, two-stage reinforcement learning procedure, rewards, and inference prompts are unchanged. The corrected summarizer training count does not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same mathematical, medical, MMLU-Pro, and open-domain QA coverage, including offline and online retrieval scenarios. Appendix C.1 changes a training quantity, not the represented tasks or domains.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain identical baseline memberships, including CoT, Standard RAG, Self-Ask, RAT, Search-o1, the CoT-RL and RAG-RL methods, and Vanilla RL. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Appendix C.1 changes the stated summarizer training quantity from approximately 360 to 360k intermediate summaries. Both versions already specify 180k samples over two epochs, supporting a localized correction to the reported setting rather than expanded training or rerun evaluations.

E4.justification: The component, summarizer, and corpus ablations; intrinsic-reasoning and online-search tests; training and retrieval analyses; unsuccessful reasoning-model experiments; and Appendix E case studies are unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix C.8 retains single-run training reporting and the targeted three-run HotpotQA evaluation, with F1 scores 71.7, 71.9, and 71.2. No uncertainty-reporting practice, repeated-run count, or statistical test changes.

E6.justification: Numerical outcomes and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 retains average F1 scores of 58.5 for Qwen-2.5-7B UR2 and 56.1 for Search-R1. The training-count correction is a setting correction, not a changed result.

T1.justification: The reward definitions, difficulty thresholds, training objective, importance weights, and advantage normalization in Equations 1–5 are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same scientific claims about unified retrieval and reasoning, cross-domain generalization, preserved reasoning ability, and comparative performance. The revised release statement concerns resource access.

C2.justification: Interpretations of retrieval–reasoning imbalance, summarization, robustness, and intrinsic reasoning remain unchanged. The Limitations section and appendix discussions of model instability, unsuccessful experiments, and deployment constraints are also retained.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces the statement that code is available at the Tsinghua-dhy/UR2 GitHub repository with 'We will release all code, models, and data,' removing the concrete access link. Appendix C.1 also corrects 360 to 360k summaries. Actual external resource availability cannot be established from these PDFs.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning in Section 2 and Section 6.4 are unchanged, including the discussion of concurrent systems and novelty under limited model capacity.

P1.justification: The publication header changes from 'Accepted at ACL 2026 Main Conference' to 'Published as a conference paper at ACL 2026 (Oral Presentation).' Other edits are limited to the release sentence, training-count correction, and version/date text; the narrative and section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Page 1 has localized abstract reflow and changed publication and version banners. All figures, tables, captions, and their placements are unchanged; Appendix C.1 has only a small local text-spacing adjustment around the corrected count.

improvement.justification: Appendix C.1 improves internal consistency by correcting 360 to 360k, matching the retained 180k samples over two epochs. Conversely, the abstract replaces a concrete code-access link with an unspecified future release promise. Scientific evidence is unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish whether the availability revision corrects an inaccurate statement or reduces access guidance to available artifacts. These competing reproducibility effects leave the net quality direction uncertain.
